title: Nick Sirianni declines to name a backup quarterback for Week 1

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Nick Sirianni declines to name a backup quarterback for Week 1
sources.description: The Eagles did not specify whether Tanner McKee or Andy Dalton will be their backup quarterback when they released their depth chart for Week 1 and head coach Nick Sirianni passed on a chance to do so during a Wednesday press conference as well.
